WHO WE ARE

Technology. Infrastructure. Business Continuity.

PT PatuhData Solusi Nusantara is a Jakarta-based technology solutions company. We supply business technology, implement IT infrastructure and business systems, and support them for the long term.

Most businesses buy hardware from one vendor, hire another to install it, and call a third when something breaks. We bring those responsibilities together, so there is one partner accountable for whether your technology actually keeps the business running.

We work with trading and distribution companies, warehousing and fulfillment operators, manufacturers, multi-branch businesses, and professional offices across Jakarta, Tangerang, Bekasi, Cikarang, and Greater Jakarta.

HOW WE OPERATE

Principles behind every engagement.

Accountability

One team owns the outcome, from quotation to long-term support.

Practicality

We recommend what your operation needs and can maintain.

Transparency

Scope, schedules, prices, and service levels are agreed in writing.

Continuity

We plan for maintenance, backups, and upgrades, not just installation day.
